requires: Desktop control on, and the person's grant for WINWORD.EXE when a step uses Desktop
task: Create a new document, type the sentence 'AgentMux skill test.', save it as skill-test.docx in your own workspace folder, close Word if you started it.
steps: Route 2 (COM): Documents.Add, Selection.TypeText, SaveAs2 with FileFormat 12, Close, Quit
Route 3/4 (Desktop), only if COM is unavailable: Ctrl+N, type the sentence, F12, type the full path, Enter, look
verify: skill-test.docx exists and is larger than 0 bytes
the zip holds word/document.xml and it contains 'AgentMux skill test.'
no WINWORD.EXE that you started is still running
record: add {skillVersion, appVersion, platform, date, runner, route, result, notes, evidenceSha256} to verification/<name>/<version>.json
